full_prompt_en: A square illuminated manuscript painting shows a blue-robed figure kneeling among plants beside a small pale animal. An elaborate narrow gold frame encloses the scene, and a deep cobalt border across the top is packed with gold curling lines, small red accents, and round ornamental medallions at the corners. Within the framed image, the kneeling figure fills most of the left half. A white head covering sits beneath a circular patterned gold halo, and the face inclines gently downward toward the animal at lower right. The long blue garment folds around bent knees and falls to the ground in fine, carefully drawn creases; its broad shape is shaded with deeper indigo at the hood and under the arms. Both hands hold a thin dark rod that crosses diagonally toward the animal. The animal stands on ocher earth, its rounded pale body, small pointed face, and short legs clearly separated from the darker vegetation. Small leafy plants, blue flowers or berries, and a cluster of orange fruit fill the lower corners with jewel-like detail. Behind the figure, many slender brown stems rise at left. A blue stream curves from the middle distance past reeds at the right, while gently rolling ocher land leads to a delicate pink towered building on the far horizon. Fine trees punctuate that distant slope under a clear blue sky. Gold is concentrated in the border and halo; blue dominates the central robe and water, while rusty orange and tan warm the ground and distant architecture. The surface is flat enough to read as decorated parchment, yet the folds and ground are modeled by many delicate strokes. Light is even and clear rather than cast from a single lamp. The close kneeling silhouette, tiny plants, distant structures, and intricate border make the small scene feel both intimate and expansive.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形泥金装饰手抄本画描绘一名蓝袍人物跪在植物之间，身旁是一只浅色小动物。精致的窄金框围住场景，顶端深钴蓝边饰密布金色卷线、细小红点和角落的圆形装饰章。画框内，跪者占据左半幅大部。白色头巾位于一圈有花纹的金色光环下，面容温和地低向右下的小动物。长蓝袍围着弯曲的膝盖落到地面，褶皱由许多细密线条描出；头罩及臂下用更深靛蓝塑造宽大形体。双手握一根细暗杆，斜斜指向动物。动物站在赭色土地上，圆润浅色身体、尖小面部和短腿与较暗植物分开。小叶片、蓝花或果实和一簇橙色果子以珠宝般的细节填充下方角落。人物后方，左侧升起许多细棕茎。蓝色溪水从中景弯向右侧芦苇，柔缓起伏的赭色土地通往远方地平线上纤细的粉红色多塔建筑。几棵细树点在远坡，头顶是清澈蓝天。金色集中于边框与光环；蓝色主导中央长袍与水，锈橙和棕褐温暖地面及远处建筑。表面足够平整，可读作装饰过的羊皮纸，但袍褶与地面又由许多细笔塑出体积。光均匀而清澈，并非由单盏灯投下。贴近的跪姿剪影、微小植物、远方建筑及繁密边框让小画面同时显得亲密与开阔。
style_prompt_en: Illuminated manuscript painting joins a precisely ruled metallic border with jewel-toned color and minute linework. Cobalt and indigo occupy strong concentrated areas, balanced by ocher, muted coral, and small gold accents. Curving ornamental marks are densely packed at the edge, while the central field opens into layered bands of fine linear detail. Contours are delicate but explicit; short parallel strokes and thin tonal shifts model folded and rounded volume without losing the flat decorated surface. Tiny rhythmic marks and repeated vertical lines create movement at the margins, while a distant pale zone gives depth. Light stays clear and even, allowing metallic highlights and pigment texture to remain legible throughout. The visual effect is intricate, intimate, and carefully balanced between flat pattern and miniature spatial recession.
style_prompt_zh: 泥金手抄本绘画把准确划出的金属色边饰、珠宝般的色彩和极细线工结合。钴蓝与靛蓝占据鲜明集中的区域，由赭色、低调珊瑚色和小块金色平衡。弯曲装饰记号在边沿密集排列，中央区域则展开分层、细密的线性细节。轮廓纤细而明确；短平行线与微小明暗变化塑造折叠和圆润体积，却不失平面装饰表面。微小的节奏性笔迹与重复竖线在边缘产生动势，远处浅色带提供纵深。光线清澈均匀，让金属亮点与颜料肌理在全幅保持可见。整体精细而亲密，在平面纹样与微型空间后退之间仔细平衡。
theme_en: A blue-robed figure kneeling beside a small pale animal in an illuminated landscape
theme_zh: 蓝袍人物在装饰画风景中跪在一只浅色小动物旁
name: Limbourg brothers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
